addr: 6th Cross Rd, Malleshwaram, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560003, India

rev.t: One of the worth to money gym in malleshwaram. The equipments are well conditioned, maintained and advanced one. Backside of the gym there is a lather track for outdoor! If you know how to workout (gym), it's the best choice!

Very easily affordable. Has most of the equipment you need but it gets crowded. You have to wait for your chance on cardio equipment like treadmill. Trainers were good when I used to go. But in the mornings at the place used to stink with the sweat of the last night's batch.
Clean, spacious, has all equipment one would expect in a decent gym, one has to pay only for the maintenance, trainers available to help in workouts, fees around 900 INR for three months.
